        "The patch adds signature, digest, content-cipher, key-size and key-encryption metadata to the S/MIME security panel.",
        "The key-encryption label describes the first recipient entry; the selected decryption certificate is obtained separately. Signature metadata is forwarded after either verification failure or success, while encryption metadata has an explicit success guard.",

        "No tests changed or ran. The new nonnegative key-size assertion has no message, and live crypto, keyboard and screen-reader behavior were not verified."
